{{Quote|And we have had no further contact with General Plo Koon. The absence of distress beacons indicates that his fleet was&hellip; that his fleet was destroyed, like the others. We are about to prepare a rescue mission.|Anakin Skywalker|audio=NoFurtherContactRescueMission.flac|<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />}}
The '''''Malevolence'' Campaign''' was an early campaign of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], revolving around the Confederate [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].
